hero.tagline: Ten unhurried seconds of jellyfish pulsing through blue water. Short enough to watch the whole thing and see the completion event fire.

contents.title: Tears of Steel
contents.description: Years after a falling-out, a scientist and a crew of misfit fighters gather on an old bridge to stage one improbable experiment: rewrite a single moment in the past and stop the machines it unleashed. A live-action and VFX short from the Blender Foundation's open movie projects.

contents.title: Big Buck Bunny
contents.description: A gentle giant of a rabbit just wants a quiet morning in the meadow. Three bored rodents have other plans, and they badly underestimate how creative a provoked bunny can be. Animated open movie, streamed here over adaptive HLS.

contents.title: Tears of Steel (Subtitled)
contents.description: The same bridge, the same desperate plan, now packaged as fragmented-MP4 HLS with a subtitle track. Open the native options menu during playback to switch captions on.

contents.title: Sintel · HD Trailer
contents.description: A lone traveller crosses frozen ridges and crowded bazaars searching for the young dragon she once raised. The 720p trailer for the Blender Foundation's third open movie.

contents.title: Big Buck Bunny · Trailer
contents.description: Half a minute of meadow mischief: the setup, the bullies, and a hint of the payback to come.

contents.title: Jellyfish Drift
contents.description: Ten unhurried seconds of jellyfish pulsing through blue water. Short enough to watch the whole thing and see the completion event fire.

contents.title: Bunny Bite
contents.description: A ten-second slice of the meadow, handy for checking playback end to end without waiting.

contents.title: Studio Reel
contents.description: A five-minute progressive MP4 that is useful for scrubbing and seek tests over a plain HTTP download.

contents.title: Adaptive Stream · Advanced
contents.description: A multi-bitrate fragmented-MP4 HLS stream with alternate audio. Good for watching the player climb and drop between quality levels.

contents.title: Adaptive Stream · 16:9
contents.description: A half-hour widescreen HLS test pattern. Long enough to background the app mid-play and come back to it.

contents.title: Adaptive Stream · 4:3
contents.description: The classic 4:3 HLS test pattern, letterboxed inside a widescreen player.
